import React, {useEffect, useState} from 'react'; import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom'; import './employeeDetails.css'; function EmployeeDetails({getEmployeeById}) { const { id } = useParams(); // get the employeeID from the URL const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]); useEffect(() => { getEmployeeById(id).then(data => setEmployees([data])); }, []); return (
{employees.map(employees => ( <>

{employees.firstName} {employees.lastName}

Email:
{employees.email}
Address:
{employees.address.street} {employees.address.postCode}
{employees.address.city} {employees.address.country}
Position:
{employees.position}
Role:
{employees.role}
Employed Date:
{employees.employedDate}
Active:
{employees.active ? "Active" : "Not Active"}
))}
) } export default EmployeeDetails
